A '''[[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]]''' [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] succeeded [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Amise Griff]] as the commander of the [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']] shortly after its completion in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].

==Biography==
[[File:ZaAdmiralChoke.jpg|thumb|left|150px|The Admiral is killed by Darth Vader.]]
The [[Officer/Legends|officer]] served as the [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] of the newly-completed [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|Star Dreadnought]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']] during the [[Warship/Legends|warship's]] maiden voyage on an interim basis in the place of Admiral [[Amise Griff]]. He reported directly to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] but was often at odds with the Dark Lord about the role of Admiral Griff in pursuing the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]].

While trying to elevate his position, the Admiral would often remind Vader of Griff's failures, hoping to elevate his own status. The admiral eventually met his end when he carelessly voiced his complaints to another crew member in front of Vader's [[Meditation chamber/Legends|meditation chamber]], believing that Vader was too busy meditating to overhear his insolence. However, Vader had overheard the Admiral's complaints, and tired of the Admiral's continuing fault-finding against his chosen servant, he [[Telekinesis/Legends#Choking powers|strangled]] the man to death.
